text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx/timeouts observed for /v1/generate in prod-us-west1 after recent deploy. p95 from 0.3s -> 1.6s, p99 from 0.6s -> 4.2s. Error class: gateway_timeout (504) and downstream conn resets. Paging SRE + runtime oncall.
alice_oncall: I'm oncall. Acknowledge. Kicking off quick triage. Which deploy rolled out? :eye:
bob_runtime: deploy id deploy-2026-03-17-22:14 (mux v2) — canary finished 22:16, started 22:14. Saw higher tail latencies in QA yesterday but within threshold.
carol_sre: Symptoms: significant queueing at gateway, many backend streams hitting read timeouts. Initial traces show large number of rpc retries and long kernel wait. Pasting representative logs:
```
[2026-03-17T22:18:05Z] runtime[pod-7f9]: warn: kv-cache miss, latency=1.2s
[2026-03-17T22:18:06Z] gateway[g-12]: error: upstream read timeout after 30s -> returning 504
[2026-03-17T22:18:07Z] runtime[pod-9]: err: connection reset by peer during stream write
```
alice_oncall: Thanks. Bob, can you confirm if mux v2 introduced any connection pooling changes or keepalive/timeout tuning? We need a rollback decision quickly if it's the deploy.
bob_runtime: Mux v2 switches to multiplexed long-lived connections and changed keepalive from 10s -> 60s to reduce churn. That could amplify stuck sockets under load. Also changed a small kernel flag for batch coalescing.
dave_prodops: Customer-facing note: hosted API is seeing elevated 5xx; some customers reported retries and slow responses. Support queue has started to spike. We should prepare a short status message if we rollback.
eve_support: Support: +8 escalations in past 10m, 3 customers asking for ETA. We need an estimated recovery timeline.
alice_oncall: Decision: roll back to deploy-2026-03-17-21 (previous stable) to stop impact. Reason: config change that affects long-lived connections and matches logs. Rollback now.
bob_runtime: Initiating rollback. Command:
```
# infra rollback
infra deploy rollback --service runtime --to-revision=deploy-2026-03-17-21
# kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime -n prod-us-west1
```
carol_sre: Noted. I'll put circuit fallback to smaller pool and enable aggressive connection close on gateway while rollback proceeds.
incident-bot: ROLLBACK_START: rollback to deploy-2026-03-17-21 initiated by bob_runtime at 6791234720.
bob_runtime: Rollback logs:
```
[22:22:01] rollback: creating rollout
[22:22:12] rollout: updated replicaset -> scaling down canary
[22:23:05] rollout: apply previous config complete
```
incident-bot: ROLLBACK_COMPLETE at 6791234825. Healthchecks passing.
alice_oncall: Monitoring post-rollback metrics. p95 dropping back towards baseline. p99 still a bit elevated but trending down. Gateway 504s reduced by ~85% in last 5m.
carol_sre: Checked connections: many stale mux sessions cleared during scale-down; kernel wait times reduced. Still watching for residual retries and backpressure.
dave_prodops: Sending short status update: "We observed a latency regression after a recent runtime change. We've rolled back to the previous deployment and are monitoring. No customer data loss. We'll follow up with a postmortem." Ready to publish when alice confirms.
alice_oncall: Publish now. Support please use templated message and route escalations to me.
eve_support: Sent customer notes. Updated tickets and escalations routed.
alice_oncall: Closing immediate page but keeping incident channel open for 30m for follow-up checks and P0 verification. Assigning postmortem to bob_runtime + carol_sre + alice_oncall. Ticket: INC-6791234
bob_runtime: Will run a focused test to reproduce with mux v2 keepalive/traffic patterns and open a pr to revert keepalive change if needed. Also will instrument socket backpressure metrics.
carol_sre: I'll grab heap/FD stats and add alert adjustments to avoid noisy pages if this is a transient startup artifact. Follow-up meeting in 1h for RCA.
alice_oncall: Thanks all. Closing channel when p99 stable < 2x baseline and support queue drained. :thumbsup:
